name: my-workbench-lanes
description: MyWorkbench specialist lanes as a packaged DSH agent-preset plugin: one delegation tool per specialist, each reading its provider/model/reasoningEffort pin from the plugin's own settings namespace, and each applying the specialist's read-only toolFilter. HOST HALF ONLY — the settings page ships as the separate profile-layer package ../lane-plugin-ui/, because client halves are only discovered on profile rows.
